entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello? I... I need to make a return, please.
Hi there, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. I can help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number?
It's Maria Garcia. Order number is... VF-881-04. I'm just so disappointed, I was really hoping this would work out.
Okay, Maria, I have your order pulled up. I see the TrailGuard helmet, delivered on October 28th. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue?

There's no issue, technically. It's just... the box is still unopened. I've been so busy, and honestly, things are a bit tight right now. I really needed this money back for bills, but I kept putting it off. I feel terrible about it.
I understand. So just to confirm, it's not a technical fault with the helmet or a concern about its safety features, but more of a preference issue?

Yes, exactly. When I saw the color in person, it just wasn't what I expected. And I couldn't bring myself to open it. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, I was just hoping for a little understanding.
Of course, Maria. I appreciate you explaining that. Let me just pull up the return policy for this specific item. Please hold one moment.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I have good news. Because the helmet is a standard item, it falls under our 90-day return policy. Since it's only been 51 days, you are well within the window to send it back for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief! Thank you so, so much. I was so worried I had waited too long.

Not at all. We want to make sure you're happy. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label right now. Just make sure the helmet is secure in its packaging, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location.
That's wonderful. You have no idea how much this helps. Thank you, Alex.
You are very welcome, Maria. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
